regime_context: Leadership is narrow: only 4 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend gate, led by Banks with a durability_bar of 0.67 but mixed Hurst and non-trending breadth. emerging_watch: Telecom & Utilities is ineligible (score 0.315) but shows the strongest non-eligible trend character in the middle of the pack (Hurst 'trend', breadth 0.667, durability_bar 0.47 just under the 0.5 threshold) — I am watching for it to cross into eligibility with durability_bar ≥ 0.5; that crossing would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only eligible theme with both leadership (rank 1, score 1.313) and a durability_bar above the 0.5 threshold (0.67), with the strongest breadth (0.692) among eligible names. Momentum is a focus lens only, but the trend-gate eligibility confirms trend discipline is active for this theme.
theses.dissent: Hurst is 'mixed' not 'trend', and Banks is not scorable (no ETF proxy), so the apparent leadership may be a short-term rate/policy artifact rather than durable trend; the gate only cut drawdown historically, it did not add returns.

falsifier.text: Banks underperforms the Hang Seng by 3% over any 10-day window before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only eligible theme with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag and the highest durability_bar (0.76) plus strong breadth (0.80), suggesting the most consistent trend discipline among eligible names. It trails Banks only modestly on score.
theses.dissent: It is unscorable (no ETF proxy) so cannot be graded, and Energy is a small H-share pocket—leadership here may reflect a global commodity beta rather than HK-specific flow.

falsifier.text: Energy loses its eligible status (score drops below the trend-gate threshold) at any point before the check-by date.

theses.thesis: High-Dividend is eligible with a solid durability_bar (0.65) and the defensive income character that tends to hold up in a narrow, mean-reverting regime. It is the third leg of the only four-theme eligible set and uncrowded.
theses.dissent: Hurst is mixed and breadth is middling (0.625); income themes often lag real-trend leadership in a rising-rate backdrop, and it is unscorable so the lean is ungradable.
